options: Which specific rows of data a user can see
Which pages, controls, and processes a user can reach
Which currency a ledger uses
How often a password must be changed
questions.explain: Function security secures the code resources behind the application — pages, buttons, tabs, and scheduled processes — not the data rows themselves.

questions.q: A data security policy pairs which two things?
options: A username and a password
A job role and an abstract role
A privilege and a duty role
A condition (a filter on the data) and a set of allowed actions on a resource, attached to a role
questions.explain: A data security policy defines a condition (such as a business unit filter) plus allowable actions against a database resource, and is attached to a role.

questions.q: A user can open the Create Invoice page but sees zero invoices. What does this combination indicate?
options: Function security failed and data security passed
Both function security and data security failed
Function security passed and data security failed
The invoice module is not licensed
questions.explain: Reaching the page means function security passed. Seeing no data despite that means no data security policy on the user's roles matches the relevant rows.

questions.q: If a user fails a function security check for a given page, what happens to the data security check for that same page?
options: It is never evaluated, because the user can't reach the page at all
It still runs and may grant access to some rows
It automatically passes as a fallback
It locks the user's account
questions.explain: If function security fails, the user cannot reach the page or control at all, so data security — which governs what's visible once a page is open — never comes into play.

questions.q: A support engineer assumes 'the user sees no data' always means 'the user has no access at all,' and re-provisions an already-correct job role. What mistake is being made?
options: No mistake — re-provisioning the job role is always the right fix
Confusing a privilege with a duty role
Assuming the user account is locked
Treating a likely data security problem as if it were a function security problem
questions.explain: Seeing no data while the page opens fine is the signature of a data security gap, not missing function security. Re-provisioning the job role fixes nothing if the role was already correct.
